ABOUT US

About Jamathul Ulama

A platform for unity, consultation and community service.

JAMATHUL ULAMA – THIRUVADANAI is a federation bringing together Islamic scholars and responsible members of the Ulama community. It aims to strengthen scholarly cooperation, provide guidance on religious and social matters, and contribute positively to the welfare of society.

WHAT WE DO

Our Activities

📚

Scholarly Guidance

Promoting sound Islamic knowledge and scholarly consultation.

🤝

Community Service

Working together for the welfare and development of the community.

🕌

Programs & Awareness

Organising educational, religious and social awareness programs.

JAMATHUL ULAMA • v37

Website Admin

Manage the President, Secretary, Treasurer and all Ulama members. You can edit or delete individual member records. Changes are saved in this browser.

💳 Subscription Settings

Yearly subscription is fixed at ₹300. Admin can record each member’s annual payment and status.

📥 Yearly Subscription Reports

Town-wise Paid / Pending lists — Select the subscription year and town, then download the list as a CSV file. The CSV opens in Excel and supports Tamil text.

📢 Announcements & Bulk Messages

Admin can publish announcements to the public News section and prepare WhatsApp bulk messages for selected members.

ADMIN PANEL

📢 Announcement Manager

Create, publish, edit or remove website announcements.

Published Announcements

ADMIN PANEL

📲 Bulk WhatsApp Message

Select recipients by town and subscription status, then open WhatsApp with the message prepared.

WhatsApp requires user interaction for each message. This tool prepares the message and opens WhatsApp one recipient at a time; it does not silently send messages.

💾 Data Backup & Restore — v37

Download a complete backup of committee, Ulama members, subscriptions and announcements. Restore the same backup later on this browser.

⚠️ v37 is still a single-browser/local-storage version. A real online multi-device database requires a backend such as Firebase/Supabase.

👤

Ulama Member Management

Search every registered Ulama member and use Edit or Delete for the selected member. Admin can open any member, edit all details, or delete the member.

Important: This single-file version uses browser local storage. For multiple admins/devices and secure online editing, connect the site to a real backend/database before publishing.
